claim: logServerAddress logs every address the server listens on, writing IPv6 addresses as [address]:port.
label: PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED
rationale: The IPv6 bracket formatting is shown; the logging loop starts at the end of the range and its body is not.

claim: formatMessage builds a message that starts with the Axios version and the transitional option name, followed by an optional extra message.
label: SUPPORTED
rationale: String concatenation of VERSION, opt, desc and message.

claim: formatMessage throws an error when the option is deprecated.
label: UNSUPPORTED
rationale: It returns a string; no throw is visible.

claim: randomId returns eight random bytes encoded as base64url.
label: SUPPORTED
CONTRADICTED
rationale: It uses randomBytes(8) in base64url, not a UUID.

claim: splitKey splits a key at its last colon into a path and an operator, and returns a null operator when the operator is not recognised.
label: SUPPORTED
rationale: lastIndexOf(':'), isWhereOperator(op) ? { path, op } : { path, op: null }.

claim: splitKey throws an error when it meets an unknown operator.
label: CONTRADICTED
rationale: Unknown operators return op null (colon form) or fall through to eq; nothing throws.

claim: canFetch returns whether the app is online when networkMode is online (the default), and true for other modes.
label: SUPPORTED

claim: canFetch retries failed fetches with exponential backoff.
label: UNSUPPORTED

claim: getValidEnumValues drops keys whose value is a reverse numeric mapping and returns the values of the remaining keys.
label: SUPPORTED

claim: base64SourceMap converts a webpack source's map into a base64 data URL.
label: SUPPORTED

claim: base64SourceMap writes the generated source map to a file on disk.
label: UNSUPPORTED
rationale: It only returns a data URL; no file writes.
